Name: JEBlock
Author: Beep Boop Bip ... Vibe Code
Punchline: Jump/Emote Block (JEBlock) complements Gagspeak. Lock your partner into an emote without forcing HARDCORE mode.
Description: When using Triggers or Puppeteer for emotes, your partner may escape by tapping jump or performing a new /emote. This plugin blocks those requests if a user configured 'Loci' effect is detected.
